handover_report.title: EverythingAI — Undo UI Validation Handover
handover_report.branch_policy: main only unless explicitly changed by the user
completed_scope: Planning page loads recent action execution history from GET /api/action-executions.
Planning page shows Undo History with undoable executed actions.
Undo buttons call POST /api/action-executions/:executionId/undo with explicit approval.
Analytics page shows recent executions and undoable action count.
Frontend refreshes files, status, and execution history after execution or undo.
Settings page surfaces allowCategory and dryRunOnly planning rules already supported by backend.

validation.evidence: User reported tsc --noEmit completed without errors and vite build completed successfully with 1544 modules transformed and production assets emitted in 4.45s.

No backend files were changed in this UI step.
Undo remains guarded by user confirmation in the UI.
Existing planning, dry-run, execute, provider settings, and source path flows remain available.
